The OSHA PSM threshold quantity (TQ) for chlorine (CAS 7782-50-5) is 1,500 lb. The source is 29 CFR 1910.119, Appendix A, "List of Highly Hazardous Chemicals, Toxics and Reactives (Mandatory)".

I checked this against the current eCFR text of 1910.119, which I fetched today. The Appendix A row reads "Chlorine 7782-50-5 1500".

- If a process holds 1,500 lb or more of chlorine, the PSM standard applies to it.
- The related chlorine compounds on the list are separate entries: chlorine dioxide, chlorine pentafluoride and chlorine trifluoride. I confirmed that chlorine pentafluoride is 1,000 lb. My text extraction cut off the values for the other two, so I have not confirmed them.
- This answer is for OSHA PSM only. EPA's RMP rule (40 CFR 68) sets its own threshold for chlorine, which I did not check here.
